Container.Name: stocktake
Container.Overview:
A self-hosted share portfolio tracker, built for Australian investors. Tracks holdings, valuations and performance; computes financial-year capital gains with FIFO parcel matching, the CGT discount and franking credits; imports broker CSV, OFX and dividend statement PDFs; and builds charts you design yourself.
Privacy is the point: only ticker symbols ever leave your server, to fetch prices. No holdings, no balances, no telemetry, no phone-home. Dividend statements are parsed locally — no cloud OCR. Turn the price feed off and it makes no outbound requests at all.
Runs on SQLite by default: one file in appdata, nothing else to install. Postgres is supported if you already run one.
SETUP: nothing to prepare. Start the container and open the WebUI — a setup wizard asks where to keep the data, creates your account, and writes the configuration file for you.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Holds stocktake.db — your entire portfolio. Back this up; it is the only thing that needs backing up.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Where the app keeps config.yaml. It writes the file itself on first run, so this folder can start out empty.

Config.Name: APP_CONFIG_FILE
Config.Description: Path to config.yaml inside the container. Leave as-is unless you renamed the file.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Set this to YOUR timezone; the setup wizard asks for it too and the two should agree. Containers run UTC, and every date decision — which financial year today is in, whether a trade is dated in the future — uses this. Leaving it wrong puts the app a day out for part of each day.

Config.Name: Database password
Config.Description: Only if you chose Postgres. Setting it here rather than in the wizard keeps the password out of config.yaml. Leave blank for the default SQLite setup.
